attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: MWCC inlines only functions DEFINED before the call site; force calls with `#pragma dont_inline on/off`. mwld strips unreferenced local functions, but stripped functions still order the sdata2 constant pool (literals first, then const objects). Literal-address forms inside Matching TUs are correct as spelled; never symbolify them.
